command.text: declare @o1 char(1), @o2 char(1) select @o1 = rtrim(val) from options where name = 'm_pb_cktm_tl_dg' select @o2 = rtrim(val) from options where name = 'l_group_input_invoice' select @o1 = isnull(@o1, '1'), @o2 = isnull(@o2, '0') select 'this._unitCode='@@unit';this._$discountAllocation=' + @o1 + ';this._$maxDescription=' + @o2 + ';load$&Identity;$Grid(this);' as message return

grid.response:
&XMLGetUOMConversion;
if exists(select 1 from dmvt where ma_vt = @ma_vt) begin exec FastBusiness$Voucher$Receipt$Item$ImportXML @unitCode, @ma_vt, @voucherCode, @@userID, @@admin, @ma_kho return end
declare @rate numeric(25, 5), @stock numeric(25, 5) if exists(select 1 from dmqddvt where dvt = @dvt and (ma_vt = @ma_vt or ma_vt = '*')) begin select @rate = he_so from dmqddvt where dvt = @dvt and (ma_vt = @ma_vt or ma_vt = '*') exec FastBusiness$Current$Stock 1, @ma_vt, @ma_kho, @ma_vi_tri, @ma_lo, '', @rate, @voucherCode, @unitCode, @action, 2, @stock output select isnull(@rate, 1) as he_so, @stock as stock return end
declare @stock numeric(25, 5) if exists(select 1 from dmvt where ma_vt = @ma_vt) begin exec FastBusiness$Current$Stock 0, @ma_vt, @ma_kho, @ma_vi_tri, '', '', 1, @voucherCode, @unitCode, @action, 2, @stock output exec FastBusiness$Voucher$Receipt$Item$ImportXML @unitCode, @ma_vt, @voucherCode, @@userID, @@admin, @ma_kho, @stock return end

query.text: select @@fieldExternal from @@prime$partition$current a left join dmvt b on a.ma_vt = b.ma_vt where @@whereClause order by @@orderByClause
